An '''Ithorian outcast''' lived in a [[Unidentified Ragmar V settlement|settlement of outcasts]] around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the final [[Time/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] took part in a [[Battle of Ragmar V|skirmish]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ragmar V]] against the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone armies]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The battle was originally planned to be set against a detachment of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]], [[Joc Sah]]. The fight suddenly took a different turn, however, when the clone troopers were ordered to execute [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]; a [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|directive]] that labeled all Jedi as traitors to the Republic and that they were to be [[Death/Legends|executed]] immediately. The settlement leader, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Gaan]], made peace with Joc Sah, and together with the other settlers they repelled the clone troopers. The Ithorian took his place on a roof with [[Unidentified Human female with ponytail|one other outcast]] for the duration of the skirmish. Once the battle had been momentarily won, the Ithorian and the other outcasts welcomed Joc Sah as one of their own. They then proceeded to counter another force of [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] that arrived to ensure Sah's death.<ref name="TOO" />
